purpose: Force Garuda to learn pre-attack precursors by excluding every sequence with attack-labelled traffic in its 8-minute history from training, calibration, policy and evaluation negatives.
source: Official CTU IoT-23 timestamped Zeek conn.log.labeled scenarios
final_validation: locked; no final-validation family may be scored while V27 development is being tuned

temporal_protocol.positive_target: history is fully benign and at least one attack-labelled network window begins in the next 4 minutes
temporal_protocol.negative_target: history is fully benign and the next 4 minutes are fully benign
temporal_protocol.heldout_family_rule: all blocks containing held-out-family history or future exposure are absent from train/calibration/policy
temporal_protocol.split: deterministic one-hour block split inherited from V23
temporal_protocol.test: clean-history held-out-family future positives plus reserved clean benign negatives

feature_policy.causal_adaptive_summary: V24 per-history median/IQR normalized network dynamics only

fusion_grid.linear_weight: remainder after tree and novelty weights

model.selection: policy-clean population only; maximize clean-history known-family future recall subject to <=2% policy benign FPR, then lower FPR

claim_boundary: A pass is evidence for forecasting held-out attack behaviours from clean network histories. It is not a claim to predict every zero-day attack.
